title: Domain notice extraction, schema version 1.0
description: One domain per notice. Consumers ignore unknown fields, so adding an optional field is a compatible change.

domain.description: Registered domain name in lowercase, without www., subdomains, scheme or path.

expires_on.description: The domain's registration expiry date as YYYY-MM-DD; null if the notice does not state it. Never invented.

registrar.description: Registrar that sent the notice; if the sender is not a registrar, the registrar named in it; else null.

amount_due.description: Money the recipient must pay or will be charged; null if nothing is due or payment is already complete.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of amount_due; null when amount_due is null.

action_required.description: True if the recipient is asked to do something; false if informational or only conditional.
